## berth repo add

register a repo and clone it

### Synopsis

register a repo and clone it

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_repo_add/

```
berth repo add <org> <owner/repo|git-url> [--dir name] [--branch b] [--no-clone] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth repo add acme acme/widgets
  berth repo add acme acme/widgets --branch main --dir widgets
```
